caption: ↔️ Lesson of the day: Spread and slippage. The spread is the gap between the buy price and the sell price, and it is a cost you pay on each trade. Slippage happens when your order is filled at a different price from the one you expected. Both can grow during major news or quiet hours. Example only: if you plan to enter at 100 but get filled at 101, your risk and reward are no longer what you planned. Check the spread before you enter, and be extra careful when the market is fast or thin. Educational content, not financial advice. Trading is high risk.
